name: Google AI Studio
summary: Google's developer playground. Google's pricing page says AI Studio usage is free of charge, while the same image and video models have no free API tier. Some of them ask for a paid API key in AI Studio (Nano Banana Pro does).

image.allowance: Not published. Which models work without a paid key isn't listed; try them in the Media section.
image.arena_note: Which image model free users get isn't stated, so no rating is shown.

video.allowance: Not published; video models may ask for a paid API key.

source_note: Gemini API pricing ("Google AI Studio usage is free of charge"; image and video models "Free tier: Not available" on the API); Google Cloud blog on Nano Banana Pro needing a paid key in AI Studio. Checked 2026-09-29.
